findings.evidence: Lines 30-41 and 46-57 are the same `heq`/`abs_le`/`simp only`/`omega` block, differing only in B↔C.
findings.fix: Factor out one lemma, e.g. `isNotG2_rationalRootSystem_of_abs_pairing_le_two (h : ∀ i j, |(t.simplyConnectedRootDatum ht).pairing i j| ≤ 2) : (t.rationalRootSystem ht).IsNotG2`, and make each instance a one-line application of it.
findings.issue: `instIsNotG2RationalRootSystemB` and `instIsNotG2RationalRootSystemC` use the same proof script. Only `simplyConnectedRootDatum_B/C` and the `abs_pairing_type{B,C}..._le_two` lemma differ.

findings.evidence: Lines ~92-94 and ~124-126 are the same `le_iSup₂ ... Finset.mem_filter.mpr ... ⟨w, rfl⟩` term.
findings.fix: Add one local helper first, `hH : ∀ d, d ∈ posRoots P b → max (b.height α) (b.height β) < b.height d → ∀ w, chevalleyRootSubgroup ρ M hM hnil d A w ∈ H`, and have `hmem`/`hdouble` supply only positivity and the height inequality. Better still, make it a private lemma outside the proof.
findings.issue: `hmem` and `hdouble` both end with the same step: `exact (le_iSup₂ (f := ...) d (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(mem_posRootsFinset P b d).mpr _, by omega⟩)) ⟨w, rfl⟩`. They also both collect `hapos`/`hcpos` height facts. This repetition is part of why the proof runs past 100 lines.

findings.evidence: `hthree` depends only on `P`, `hcast`, and `coefficients_of_pos_nsmul_add_pos_nsmul_mem`, not on `ρ`, `M`, `A`, `α`, or `β`.
findings.fix: Lift `hthree` and the `hcast` transport into private top-level lemmas about `t.simplyConnectedRootDatum ht` under `IsNotG2`. That shortens the main proof and makes both reusable.
findings.issue: `hthree` (no triple string for linearly independent roots outside G₂, transported to the integral datum) is a general fact that has nothing to do with the commutators being collected here, yet it is written inline in the long proof.

summary: The two `IsNotG2` instance proofs are the same 12-line script copied twice, and the 110-line `commutator_mem_higher_roots` repeats one `le_iSup₂`/`Finset.mem_filter` membership step that should be a single helper.
